directions.title: 硬件与传感器伙伴
directions.description: 你的模块想经受真实荒野的考验？装上车，我们带它跑遍山川湖海，输出真实环境的长测数据。
directions.description_en: Want your module tested in the real wilderness? Mount it on the vehicle — we'll take it across the country and share long-term field data.

directions.title: AI 开发者
directions.description: 在弱网、边缘算力、真实人群的场景里，部署和验证你的模型、Agent 与应用。
directions.description_en: Deploy and validate your models, agents and apps under weak networks, edge compute and real audiences.

directions.title: 科研与教育机构
directions.description: 一个移动的野外数据采集平台和科普课堂，可以开到你需要的任何地方。
directions.description_en: A mobile field-data platform and science classroom that can drive to wherever you need it.

directions.title: 在地社区与组织
directions.description: 一起把科技带进你的社区、学校和乡村，让更多人亲手触碰到技术的进步。
directions.description_en: Bring technology into your community, school or village — and let more people touch real progress with their own hands.

programs.title: 你有场景与需求
programs.title_en: You have a scenario and a need
programs.description: 你在当地发现了真实的场景与需求，或者想学习这方面的技术——这就是共创的起点。
programs.description_en: You've found a real scenario and need where you live, or you want to learn this technology — that's where co-creation starts.

programs.title: 联系我们
programs.description: 告诉我们你的场景、需求和想法，我们一起评估怎么做、需要什么。
programs.description_en: Tell us your scenario, needs and ideas — we'll work out the how and the what together.

programs.title: 我们开车过去
programs.description: 基地车开到你所在的地方，现场做培训，一起把方案跑通、落地实施。
programs.description_en: The base vehicle drives to your place — we train on site and land the solution together.
